args.sql:
SELECT 
    DATE_TRUNC('month', regmoment) AS registration_month,
    testgrp AS ab_test_group,
    COUNT(*) AS total_registrations,
    (COUNT(*) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('month', regmoment))) AS percentage_within_month
FROM 
    users
GROUP BY 
    registration_month, ab_test_group
ORDER BY 
    registration_month, ab_test_group;
